audio/ar-cups-for-friends-hint.mp3.text: ضَعْ بَطَاقَةً هُنَا، ثُمَّ بَطَاقَةً هُنَاكَ. هَلْ تَتَقَابَلُ الْبَطَاقَاتُ؟

audio/ar-cups-for-friends-prompt.mp3.text: وَزِّعْ ٤ بَطَاقَاتِ أَكْوَابٍ عَلَى سَلَّتَيْنِ بِالتَّسَاوِي.

audio/ar-cups-for-friends-real.mp3.text: رَتِّبْ بَطَاقَاتِ أَكْوَابٍ لِشَخْصَيْنِ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ.

audio/ar-double-pattern-hint.mp3.text: أَشِرْ إِلَى الْجُزْءِ الْمُتَكَرِّرِ. جَرِّبْ نَفْسَ الْقَاعِدَةِ بِصُوَرٍ أُخْرَى.

audio/ar-double-pattern-prompt.mp3.text: أَكْمِلِ النَّمَطَ. اِكْتَشِفْ مَا يَتَكَرَّرُ وَاحْكِهِ.

audio/ar-double-pattern-real.mp3.text: اِرْسُمْ رَمْزَيْنِ جَدِيدَيْنِ وَابْنِ بِهِمَا نَفْسَ النَّمَطِ.

audio/ar-fair-eight-hint.mp3.text: هَلْ لِكُلِّ بَطَاقَةٍ فِي السَّلَّةِ مُقَابِلَةٌ فِي الْأُخْرَى؟

audio/ar-fair-eight-prompt.mp3.text: وَزِّعْ ٨ بَطَاقَاتِ كُرَاتٍ بِالتَّسَاوِي بَيْنَ سَلَّتَيْنِ.

audio/ar-fair-eight-real.mp3.text: قَسِّمْ بَطَاقَاتِ اللُّعَبِ بِالتَّسَاوِي عَلَى شَخْصَيْنِ.

audio/ar-guide-coach.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ نَمَطًا وَصُوَرًا وَمَدَى الْعَدَدِ. نُجَهِّزُ طَلَبًا مُخْتَلِفًا كُلَّ مَرَّةٍ.

audio/ar-guide-combine.mp3.text: اِضْغَطْ عَلَى صُوَرِ الْمَجْمُوعَتَيْنِ لِتَضُمَّهَا فِي سَلَّةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ.

audio/ar-guide-compare.mp3.text: أَيُّ صَفٍّ فِيهِ بَطَاقَاتٌ أَكْثَرُ؟ الْعَدَدُ هُوَ الْمُهِمُّ، وَلَيْسَ التَّبَاعُدَ.

audio/ar-guide-count.mp3.text: اِضْغَطْ عَلَى الصُّورَةِ لِتَضَعَ بَطَاقَةً فِي السَّلَّةِ.

audio/ar-guide-demo.mp3.text: هَذَا مِثَالٌ لِلطَّرِيقَةِ. طَلَبُكَ الْأَصْلِيُّ يَنْتَظِرُكَ.

audio/ar-guide-fill.mp3.text: أَكْمِلِ السَّلَّةَ حَتَّى تُطَابِقَ بَطَاقَةَ الطَّلَبِ.

audio/ar-guide-library.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ تَجْرِبَةً وَالْعَبْ. فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ طَلَبٌ جَدِيدٌ وَصُوَرٌ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ.

audio/ar-guide-match.mp3.text: عَدَدُ الْبَطَاقَاتِ يَطَابِقُ الطَّلَبَ. اِحْكِ طَرِيقَتَكَ.

audio/ar-guide-measure.mp3.text: ضَعِ الْبَطَاقَاتِ الْمُتَسَاوِيَةَ عَلَى الْخَطِّ دُونَ فَرَاغٍ أَوْ تَدَاخُلٍ.

audio/ar-guide-mixed.mp3.text: عُدَّ بَطَاقَاتِ كُلِّ صُورَةٍ وَطَابِقْهَا بِالطَّلَبِ.

audio/ar-guide-pattern.mp3.text: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى تَرْتِيبِ الصُّوَرِ. اِخْتَرِ الصُّورَةَ التَّالِيَةَ.

audio/ar-guide-pause.mp3.text: حَفِظْنَا مَكَانَكَ إِنْ كَانَ الْحَفْظُ مُتَاحًا. خُذْ وَقْتَكَ وَعُدْ عِنْدَمَا تَكُونُ مُسْتَعِدًّا.

audio/ar-guide-retry.mp3.text: لِنُعِدِ الْفَحْصَ بِهُدُوءٍ. قَارِنِ الْبَطَاقَاتِ بِالطَّلَبِ، أَوِ اِطْلُبْ تَلْمِيحًا.

audio/ar-guide-return.mp3.text: اِضْغَطْ عَلَى بَطَاقَةٍ فِي السَّلَّةِ لِإِعَادَةِ الزَّائِدِ.

audio/ar-guide-review.mp3.text: اِحْكِ كَيْفَ حَلَلْتَ الطَّلَبَ. يُمْكِنُكَ حِفْظُهُ أَوْ طِبَاعَتُهُ وَتَبَادُلُ الدَّوْرِ.

audio/ar-guide-role.mp3.text: أَنَا الْبَائِعُ الْآنَ. أَصْنَعُ طَلَبًا وَاضِحًا وَأَفْحَصُهُ مَعَ الْمَرَافِقِ.

audio/ar-guide-safety.mp3.text: اِسْتَخْدِمْ بَطَاقَاتٍ أَوْ قِطَعًا كَبِيرَةً آمِنَةً مَعَ الْمَرَافِقِ. لَا يَلْزَمُ طَعَامٌ حَقِيقِيٌّ.

audio/ar-guide-share.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ سَلَّةً، ثُمَّ اضْغَطْ عَلَى الصُّورَةِ. وَزِّعْ كُلَّ الْبَطَاقَاتِ بِالتَّسَاوِي.

audio/ar-guide-split.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ سَلَّةً، ثُمَّ ضَعْ بَطَاقَةً. اصْنَعْ مَجْمُوعَتَيْنِ بِطَرِيقَتِكَ.

audio/ar-join-order-hint.mp3.text: اِنْقُلْ كُلَّ بَطَاقَةٍ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً، ثُمَّ عُدَّ السَّلَّةَ الْجَدِيدَةَ.

audio/ar-join-order-prompt.mp3.text: اِنْقُلْ بَطَاقَاتِ السَّلَّتَيْنِ إِلَى سَلَّةِ الطَّلَبِ. كَمْ بَطَاقَةً أَصْبَحَ لَدَيْكَ؟

audio/ar-join-order-real.mp3.text: اِجْمَعْ مَجْمُوعَتَيْنِ مِنْ بَطَاقَاتٍ كَبِيرَةٍ فِي طَلَبٍ وَاحِدٍ.

audio/ar-little-order-hint.mp3.text: لِكُلِّ بَطَاقَةٍ مَكَانٌ. أَشِرْ إِلَيْهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعُدُّ.

audio/ar-measure-shelf-hint.mp3.text: اِسْتَخْدِمْ نَفْسَ الْوَحْدَةِ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، ثُمَّ عُدَّ الْوَحَدَاتِ.

audio/ar-measure-shelf-prompt.mp3.text: غَطِّ طُولَ الرَّفِّ بِبَطَاقَاتِ كُتُبٍ مُتَسَاوِيَةٍ، بِدُونِ فَرَاغٍ أَوْ تَدَاخُلٍ.

audio/ar-measure-shelf-real.mp3.text: قِسْ طُولَ كِتَابٍ بِوَحْدَاتٍ وَرَقِيَّةٍ مُتَسَاوِيَةٍ.

audio/ar-missing-order-hint.mp3.text: عُدَّ مَا فِي السَّلَّةِ، ثُمَّ اِمْلَأِ الْأَمَاكِنَ الْفَارِغَةَ حَتَّى يَكْتَمِلَ الطَّلَبُ.

audio/ar-missing-order-prompt.mp3.text: الطَّلَبُ ٥ بَطَاقَاتِ جَزَرٍ. فِي السَّلَّةِ ٣. أَكْمِلِ الطَّلَبَ.

audio/ar-missing-order-real.mp3.text: أَخْفِ بَعْضَ بَطَاقَاتِ طَلَبٍ، وَدَعِ الْمَرَافِقَ يُكْمِلُهُ.

audio/ar-mixed-order-hint.mp3.text: قَارِنْ كُلَّ نَوْعٍ بِطَلَبِهِ. الْمَجْمُوعُ وَحْدَهُ لَا يَكْفِي.

audio/ar-mixed-order-prompt.mp3.text: جَهِّزْ ٢ مِنْ بَطَاقَاتِ الْجَزَرِ وَ٣ مِنْ بَطَاقَاتِ الطَّمَاطِمِ.

audio/ar-mixed-order-real.mp3.text: اِصْنَعْ طَلَبًا بِصُورَتَيْنِ مُخْتَلِفَتَيْنِ وَتَبَادَلِ الدَّوْرَ.

audio/ar-more-or-longer-hint.mp3.text: جَرِّبْ عَرْضَ بَطَاقَةٍ مُقَابِلَ بَطَاقَةٍ. هَلْ تَبْقَى بَطَاقَةٌ؟

audio/ar-more-or-longer-prompt.mp3.text: أَيُّ صَفٍّ فِيهِ بَطَاقَاتٌ أَكْثَرُ؟ لَا تَعْتَمِدْ عَلَى طُولِهِ.

audio/ar-more-or-longer-real.mp3.text: قَارِنْ صَفَّيْنِ مِنْ بَطَاقَاتِ الْوَرَقِ، ثُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمَا.

audio/ar-return-extras-hint.mp3.text: قَارِنْ بَطَاقَاتِ السَّلَّةِ بِبَطَاقَةِ الطَّلَبِ. اِضْغَطْ عَلَى بَطَاقَةٍ لِإِعَادَتِهَا.

audio/ar-return-extras-prompt.mp3.text: فِي السَّلَّةِ ٩ بَطَاقَاتٍ. الطَّلَبُ ٦. أَعِدِ الزَّائِدَ إِلَى الرَّفِ.

audio/ar-return-extras-real.mp3.text: اِطْلُبْ كَمِّيَّةً أَقَلَّ مِمَّا عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ، ثُمَّ أَعِدِ الزَّائِدَ.

audio/ar-seller-today-hint.mp3.text: اِجْعَلِ الطَّلَبَ وَاضِحًا: نَوْعُ الْبَطَاقَةِ وَعَدَدُهَا.

audio/ar-seller-today-prompt.mp3.text: صَمِّمْ طَلَبَكَ، ثُمَّ دَعِ الْمَرَافِقَ يُجَهِّزُهُ وَافْحَصْهُ مَعَهُ.

audio/ar-seller-today-real.mp3.text: تَبَادَلَا دَوْرَ الْبَائِعِ وَالْمُشْتَرِي فِي سُوقٍ وَرَقِيٍّ.

audio/ar-shelf-pattern-hint.mp3.text: اِبْحَثْ عَنِ الْجُزْءِ الَّذِي يَتَكَرَّرُ. اِبْدَأْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الرَّفِ.

audio/ar-shelf-pattern-prompt.mp3.text: أَكْمِلْ نَمَطَ الرَّفِ، ثُمَّ اِحْكِ الْقَاعِدَةَ.

audio/ar-shelf-pattern-real.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ صُوَرًا جَدِيدَةً وَطَبِّقْ نَفْسَ الْقَاعِدَةِ.

audio/ar-small-pattern-hint.mp3.text: اِسْمَعْ أَسْمَاءَ الْبَطَاقَاتِ الْمَوْجُودَةِ، ثُمَّ جَرِّبْ تَكْرَارَهَا.

audio/ar-small-pattern-prompt.mp3.text: أَكْمِلْ نَمَطَ الرَّفِ. تَابِعْ نَفْسَ التَّرْتِيبِ.

audio/ar-three-baskets-hint.mp3.text: وَزِّعْ بِالدَّوْرِ عَلَى السَّلَالِ. اِفْحَصْهَا بِالْمُطَابَقَةِ وَالْعَدِّ.

audio/ar-three-baskets-real.mp3.text: صَمِّمْ طَلَبًا يُقْسَمُ بِالتَّسَاوِي عَلَى أَكْثَرَ مِنْ شَخْصٍ.

audio/ar-two-friends-hint.mp3.text: وَزِّعْ بِالدَّوْرِ، ثُمَّ قَابِلْ كُلَّ بَطَاقَةٍ بِبَطَاقَةٍ.

audio/ar-two-friends-prompt.mp3.text: وَزِّعْ ٦ بَطَاقَاتِ فَرَاوْلَةٍ بِالتَّسَاوِي بَيْنَ سَلَّتَيْنِ.

audio/ar-two-friends-real.mp3.text: اِسْتَخْدِمْ بَطَاقَاتٍ كَبِيرَةً لِتَقْسِيمِ طَلَبٍ بَيْنَ صَدِيقَيْنِ.

audio/ar-two-ways-hint.mp3.text: غَيِّرْ تَقْسِيمَ السَّلَّتَيْنِ. هَلْ تَغَيَّرَ الْمَجْمُوعُ؟

audio/ar-two-ways-prompt.mp3.text: قَسِّمْ ٨ بَطَاقَاتٍ بَيْنَ سَلَّتَيْنِ. ضَعْ بَطَاقَاتٍ فِي كِلْتَيْهِمَا.

audio/ar-two-ways-real.mp3.text: رَتِّبْ نَفْسَ الْبَطَاقَاتِ فِي مَجْمُوعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ غَيِّرْ تَقْسِيمَهَا.

audio/en-cups-for-friends-hint.mp3.text: Give one card here, then one there. Match the cards in pairs.

audio/en-cups-for-friends-prompt.mp3.text: Share 4 cup cards equally between 2 baskets.

audio/en-cups-for-friends-real.mp3.text: Set out paper cup cards for two people at a table.

audio/en-double-pattern-hint.mp3.text: Point to the repeating part. Try the same rule with new pictures.

audio/en-double-pattern-prompt.mp3.text: Continue the pattern. Find and describe what repeats.

audio/en-double-pattern-real.mp3.text: Draw two new symbols and use the same pattern rule.

audio/en-fair-eight-hint.mp3.text: Can you match every card in one basket with a card in the other?

audio/en-fair-eight-prompt.mp3.text: Share 8 ball cards equally between 2 baskets.

audio/en-fair-eight-real.mp3.text: Share paper toy cards equally between two people.

audio/en-guide-coach.mp3.text: Choose an activity, pictures and a number range. We make a different order each time.

audio/en-guide-combine.mp3.text: Tap the pictures in the two groups to join them in one basket.

audio/en-guide-compare.mp3.text: Which row has more cards? Quantity matters, not the spacing.

audio/en-guide-count.mp3.text: Tap the picture to put a card in the basket.

audio/en-guide-demo.mp3.text: This is an example of how to play. Your own order is waiting.

audio/en-guide-fill.mp3.text: Complete the basket until it matches the order card.

audio/en-guide-library.mp3.text: Choose an activity and play. Each time brings a new order and different pictures.

audio/en-guide-match.mp3.text: The cards match the order. Tell how you did it.

audio/en-guide-measure.mp3.text: Put equal cards along the line with no gaps or overlaps.

audio/en-guide-mixed.mp3.text: Count the cards of each picture and match them to the order.

audio/en-guide-pattern.mp3.text: Look at the order of the pictures. Choose the next picture.

audio/en-guide-pause.mp3.text: Your place is kept when storage is available. Take your time and return when ready.

audio/en-guide-retry.mp3.text: Let us check again. Match the cards to the order, or ask for a hint.

audio/en-guide-return.mp3.text: Tap a card in the basket to return the extras.

audio/en-guide-review.mp3.text: Tell how you solved the order. Save or print it, then swap roles.

audio/en-guide-role.mp3.text: I am the seller now. I make a clear order and check it with my grown-up.

audio/en-guide-safety.mp3.text: Use cards or large safe pieces with your grown-up. Real food is not needed.

audio/en-guide-share.mp3.text: Choose a basket, then tap the picture. Share all the cards equally.

audio/en-guide-split.mp3.text: Choose a basket, then add a card. Make two groups in your own way.

audio/en-join-order-hint.mp3.text: Move every card once, then count the new basket.

audio/en-join-order-prompt.mp3.text: Move both groups into the order basket. How many cards do you have now?

audio/en-join-order-real.mp3.text: Combine two groups of large paper cards into one order.

audio/en-little-order-hint.mp3.text: Touch each card once as you count. Try the spaces in the frame.

audio/en-little-order-prompt.mp3.text: Put 3 apple cards in the basket.

audio/en-little-order-real.mp3.text: Make a small order using paper cards.

audio/en-measure-shelf-hint.mp3.text: Use the same unit in each space, then count the units.

audio/en-measure-shelf-prompt.mp3.text: Cover the shelf with equal book cards, with no gaps or overlaps.

audio/en-measure-shelf-real.mp3.text: Measure a book with equal paper units.

audio/en-missing-order-hint.mp3.text: Count the cards you have. Fill spaces until the order is complete.

audio/en-missing-order-prompt.mp3.text: The order needs 5 carrot cards. The basket has 3. Complete it.

audio/en-missing-order-real.mp3.text: Hide some cards from an order and let your grown-up complete it.

audio/en-mixed-order-hint.mp3.text: Check each kind against its order. The total alone is not enough.

audio/en-mixed-order-prompt.mp3.text: Prepare 2 carrot cards and 3 tomato cards.

audio/en-mixed-order-real.mp3.text: Make an order with two kinds of pictures and swap roles.

audio/en-more-or-longer-hint.mp3.text: Match one card from each row. Is a card left over?

audio/en-more-or-longer-prompt.mp3.text: Which row has more cards? A longer row may have fewer cards.

audio/en-more-or-longer-real.mp3.text: Compare two rows of paper cards, then change the spaces between them.

audio/en-return-extras-hint.mp3.text: Match the basket to the order card. Tap a card to return it.

audio/en-return-extras-prompt.mp3.text: The basket has 9 cards. The order needs 6. Return the extras.

audio/en-return-extras-real.mp3.text: Ask for fewer cards than are on the table, then return the extras.

audio/en-seller-today-hint.mp3.text: Make the order clear: the kind of card and its quantity.

audio/en-seller-today-prompt.mp3.text: Design your order. Let your grown-up prepare it, then check together.

audio/en-seller-today-real.mp3.text: Swap buyer and seller roles in a paper market.

audio/en-shelf-pattern-hint.mp3.text: Find the part that repeats. Start from the beginning of the shelf.

audio/en-shelf-pattern-prompt.mp3.text: Complete the shelf pattern, then tell its rule.

audio/en-shelf-pattern-real.mp3.text: Choose new pictures and use the same repeating rule.

audio/en-small-pattern-hint.mp3.text: Say the names of the cards already there. Try repeating that order.

audio/en-small-pattern-prompt.mp3.text: Continue the shelf pattern. Keep the same order.

audio/en-small-pattern-real.mp3.text: Make a pattern with two different kinds of paper cards.

audio/en-three-baskets-hint.mp3.text: Give one to each basket in turn. Check by matching and counting.

audio/en-three-baskets-real.mp3.text: Design an order that can be shared equally by several people.

audio/en-two-friends-hint.mp3.text: Take turns adding one card to each basket. Match the groups.

audio/en-two-friends-prompt.mp3.text: Share 6 strawberry cards equally between 2 baskets.

audio/en-two-friends-real.mp3.text: Use large paper cards to share an order between two friends.

audio/en-two-ways-hint.mp3.text: Try another split. Did the total number change?

audio/en-two-ways-prompt.mp3.text: Split 8 cards between 2 baskets. Put cards in both baskets.

audio/en-two-ways-real.mp3.text: Split the same paper cards into two groups, then change the split.
